scale.display: text-6xl md:text-8xl tracking-tight leading-none font-light italic
scale.caption: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-semibold text-accent

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-white transition-all duration-300 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium tracking-wide shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(252,211,77,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(255,255,255,0.5)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10 hover:border-white/40 transition-all duration-300 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg backdrop-blur-md
buttons.ghost: text-muted-foreground hover:text-white transition-colors uppercase tracking-widest text-sm

cards.glass: bg-card backdrop-blur-xl border border-card_border rounded-2xl hover:border-primary/30 transition-all duration-500 hover:-translate-y-2 group relative overflow-hidden
cards.feature: bg-gradient-to-br from-white/5 to-white/0 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-8 hover:bg-white/10 transition-all duration-300

inputs.default: bg-white/5 border-white/10 focus:border-primary/50 text-white placeholder:text-white/30 rounded-lg h-12 px-4 transition-all

layout_strategies.hero: Full-screen cinematic background (video/image) with heavy bottom gradient. Centered typography. 'Scroll to explore' indicator.
layout_strategies.bento_grid: Asymmetric grid (12 cols). Span-8 for hero images, Span-4 for details. Gap-4 or Gap-6.
layout_strategies.tracing_beam: Use for the 'Trip Builder' tech section. A glowing line that follows the scroll path connecting features.
layout_strategies.parallax: Subtle y-axis movement on background images and floating decorative elements.

motion.entrance: opacity-0 translate-y-8 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-8 duration-700 ease-out fill-mode-forwards

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' with thin stroke widths (1.5px) to match the elegance.

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure gold text is only used on very dark backgrounds. Use white for body text.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Disable parallax and smooth scroll if preferred-reduced-motion is true.

workflow: 1. Setup Tailwind config with the specified colors and fonts.
2. Create the 'Navbar' with a glass effect (backdrop-blur-md).
3. Build the 'Hero' section using the Tokyo Neon image with a heavy dark overlay.
4. Implement the 'Trending Destinations' using a Bento Grid layout.
5. Build 'Trip Builder' tech section using the 'Tracing Beam' concept (or vertical timeline) with the abstract tech images.
6. Create 'Services' section using a horizontal scroll or grid of Glass Cards.
7. Add 'Stats' section with large animated numbers.
critical_rules: DO NOT use generic travel templates.
DO NOT use 'Inter' font for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond.
Keep the dark mode enabled by default.
Ensure all images have alt text.

general: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
Text hierarchy is created by weight and family contrast (Serif Headings vs Sans Body).
Interactive elements must have immediate feedback (hover scale, brightness).
components: Use Shadcn UI for complex interactives (Forms, Dialogs).
Use Custom HTML/Tailwind for layout structures (Grids, Heros).
Override Shadcn defaults to match the 'Jewel & Luxury' theme (e.g., rounded-none or rounded-2xl, not rounded-md).
